subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-11 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: Anthropic 启动 IPO 估值 1.3 万亿美元；纽约 AI 安全法生效；俄乌在阿布扎比重启谈判
headline_en: Anthropic launches $1.3tn IPO; New York's AI safety law takes effect; Russia and Ukraine restart talks in Abu Dhabi

items.title_zh: Anthropic 启动 IPO，估值 1.3 万亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO at $1.3 trillion valuation
items.body_zh: Claude 母公司 Anthropic 的 IPO 定价区间为每股 70 至 78 美元，低于此前预期，对应估值约 1.3 万亿美元。七位联合创始人将各自出售相同数量的股份，每人套现约 2.5 亿美元，同时仍保持对公司的控制权。
items.body_en: Anthropic, maker of the Claude chatbot, has set its IPO price range at $70 to $78 a share, below earlier expectations, implying a valuation of roughly $1.3 trillion. All seven co-founders will sell an identical number of shares, cashing out about $250 million each while keeping control of the company.

items.title_zh: 纽约 AI 安全法生效，OpenAI、Anthropic 面临新监管
items.title_en: New York's AI safety law takes effect, bringing new oversight for OpenAI and Anthropic
items.body_zh: 纽约州开始执行其全面的 AI 安全法，要求 OpenAI、Anthropic 等大型开发商注册、披露安全实践，并报告重大事故，否则将面临罚款。同日，州长 Hochul 宣布成立新的 AI 科学研究机构，称纽约要在 AI 科学与安全上领跑全国。
items.body_en: New York is enforcing its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices and report critical incidents or face fines. On the same day, Governor Kathy Hochul announced a new AI research institute, saying the state will lead the nation in AI science and safety.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 收购 Sonder 创始人创办的旅行初创 Odessia
items.title_en: OpenAI acquires Odessia, a travel startup founded by Sonder's creator
items.body_zh: OpenAI 宣布收购旅行初创公司 Odessia，后者由 Sonder 创始人 Francis Davidson 创办。OpenAI 尚未说明对旅行业务的规划，但这笔交易把一位知名旅行创业者纳入其体系。
items.body_en: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup created by Sonder founder Francis Davidson. OpenAI has not said what it plans to do in travel, but the deal brings a well-known travel entrepreneur into its orbit.

items.title_zh: Grok Build 编程代理泄露大量机密信息
items.title_en: Grok Build coding agent leaks troves of confidential data
items.body_zh: 研究人员发现约 3.5 万个 Grok Build 应用对任何查找者完全开放，泄露的信息中部分属于 SpaceX。这再次暴露 AI 编程代理在默认配置上的安全风险。
items.body_en: A researcher found about 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them, with some of the leaked information belonging to SpaceX. The incident highlights the security risks of AI coding agents left on default settings.

items.title_zh: AI 训练初创 Mercor 最新融资估值 200 亿美元
items.title_en: AI training startup Mercor valued at $20 billion in latest round
items.body_zh: 据路透社报道，AI 训练数据初创公司 Mercor 在最新一轮融资中估值达到 200 亿美元。这一数字反映出市场对高质量训练数据和标注服务的持续押注。
items.body_en: AI training startup Mercor has been valued at $20 billion in its latest funding round, Reuters reported. The figure reflects continued investor appetite for high-quality training data and labeling services.

items.title_zh: Oura 以 6.25 亿美元收购 AI 初级医疗公司 Counsel Health
items.title_en: Oura to buy AI primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.body_zh: 智能戒指厂商 Oura 宣布以 6.25 亿美元收购 Counsel Health，后者自称“AI 原生初级医疗公司”，今年早些时候其 AI 聊天机器人已接入 Oura 应用。这笔交易发生在 Oura 以“IPO 市场不确定”为由无限期推迟最高 22 亿美元 IPO 之后数周。
items.body_en: Smart ring maker Oura agreed to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million; the startup calls itself an "AI-native primary care company" and its chatbot was added to Oura's app earlier this year. The deal comes weeks after Oura indefinitely postponed an IPO of up to $2.2 billion, citing uncertainty in the IPO market.

items.title_zh: X-energy 获准在得州建四座小型模块化核反应堆
items.title_en: X-energy wins permit to build four small modular reactors in Texas
items.body_zh: 美国核管理委员会向 X-energy 颁发建设许可，允许其在得克萨斯州建造四座小型模块化反应堆。这是 AI 数据中心用电需求激增背景下，核能扩张迈出的实质性一步。
items.body_en: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission granted X-energy a construction permit to build four small modular reactors in Texas. It is a concrete step in nuclear expansion as AI data centers drive electricity demand sharply higher.

items.title_zh: 美军对发射运力紧张感到不安
items.title_en: US military grows nervous about launch supply crunch
items.body_zh: Ars Technica 报道称，美国军方对火箭发射运力紧张公开表达担忧，一名相关人士称“发射极其受限，这正是我们预测的局面”。在卫星部署与商业航天需求同时上升的当下，运力瓶颈正成为现实约束。
items.body_en: The U.S. military is voicing concern about a launch supply crunch, with one official quoted saying "launch is extremely constrained and that is exactly the situation we predicted." With satellite deployment and commercial space demand both rising, the bottleneck is becoming a real constraint.

items.title_zh: Starlink Mini 2 增加可更换电池，售价 999 美元
items.title_en: Starlink Mini 2 adds a swappable battery at $999
items.body_zh: SpaceX 发布新版一体化卫星上网终端 Starlink Mini 2，把天线、Wi-Fi 路由器和电池集成进约笔记本电脑大小的设备。部分用户在 X 上晒出的订购邀请显示其售价为 999 美元。
items.body_en: SpaceX announced Starlink Mini 2, an all-in-one satellite internet terminal that packs a dish, Wi-Fi router and now a battery into a device about the size of a laptop. Screenshots of order invitations shared on X by some users show a price of $999.

items.title_zh: 索尼取消服务型射击游戏《Fairgame$》
items.body_zh: 据彭博社报道，索尼已取消 2023 年公布的团队劫案射击游戏《Fairgame$》。索尼在内部邮件中称，测试显示玩家反馈和留存率参差不齐，未达目标，加上 PvP 射击市场竞争激烈；PlayStation 表示这不会导致 Haven Studios 裁员。
items.body_en: Sony has canceled Fairgames, the heist shooter announced in 2023, according to Bloomberg. In an internal email Sony said test results showed mixed player feedback and retention that fell short of targets, compounded by a tough PvP shooter market; PlayStation said the cancellation will not lead to layoffs at Haven Studios.

items.title_zh: PlayStation Plus PC 应用将于 12 月 10 日关闭
items.title_en: PlayStation Plus PC app shuts down December 10
items.body_zh: 索尼宣布 12 月 10 日停用 PC 版 PlayStation Plus 应用，该应用此前允许 Premium 订阅用户在 PC 上串流部分游戏。索尼称符合条件的游戏数量“非常少”，实际使用人数有限。
items.body_en: Sony is retiring the PlayStation Plus app for PC on December 10. The app let Premium subscribers stream certain games on PC, but Sony said there were a "very small number" of eligible titles and few users took advantage of the perk.

items.title_zh: 英伟达聘请美国大律所调查“中国间谍”传闻
items.title_en: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
items.body_zh: 在曝出 CEO 黄仁勋与一名被指为中国间谍的女性有染后，英伟达聘请了一家美国大型律师事务所展开调查。此事已从个人丑闻升级为牵动公司治理与地缘敏感性的问题，尚待确认的细节仍在浮现。
items.body_en: Nvidia has hired a major U.S. law firm to investigate after it emerged that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China. What began as a personal scandal has grown into a governance and geopolitical sensitivity issue, with details still emerging.

items.title_zh: 俄乌在阿布扎比举行近四小时美方斡旋会谈
items.title_en: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly four hours of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
items.body_zh: 俄乌代表在阿布扎比举行约四小时会谈，由美方斡旋，这是时隔九个月双方再次直接接触。特朗普称战争可以“很快结束”，欧洲则争取在谈判桌上占有一席之地，与此同时双方互袭仍在继续。
items.body_en: Russian and Ukrainian representatives held nearly four hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, their first direct contact in nine months. Trump said the war can "end soon," while Europe is pressing for a seat at the table and cross-border strikes continue.

items.title_zh: 马来西亚前总理纳吉布出狱，转为居家监禁
items.title_en: Malaysia's former PM Najib leaves jail for house arrest
items.body_zh: 因 1MDB 主权财富基金数十亿美元丑闻被定罪马来西亚前总理纳吉布·拉扎克已离开监狱，转为居家监禁。这一进展再次引发外界对马来西亚反腐力度与政治交易的讨论。
items.body_en: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak, convicted over the multibillion-dollar 1MDB sovereign wealth fund scandal, has left prison to serve his sentence under house arrest. The move has revived debate over Malaysia's anti-corruption resolve and political dealmaking.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯独立报纸《新报》关闭莫斯科新闻部
items.title_en: Russia's independent newspaper Novaya Gazeta closes Moscow newsroom
items.body_zh: 俄罗斯最著名的独立报纸《新报》在政府压力下关闭其莫斯科新闻部，结束三十多年的运营。这是俄罗斯独立媒体空间进一步收缩的最新标志。
items.body_en: Novaya Gazeta, Russia's best-known independent newspaper, has shut its Moscow newsroom after more than 30 years, citing government pressure. It is the latest sign of the further shrinking of Russia's independent media space.

quick_zh: 美国 10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4%，高于预期，住房、食品和能源价格是主要推手。
美国从英国两处基地撤离军用飞机，原因是来自伊朗的威胁，英方称基地安全。
西班牙国王与王后出席托莱多附近列车相撞事故遇难者纪念活动，事故造成 69 人死亡。
quick_en: U.S. October CPI rose 0.4% month over month, above expectations, driven by shelter, food and energy costs.
The U.S. moved military aircraft from two British bases amid threats from Iran; Britain says its bases are safe.
Spain's king and queen attended a memorial for victims of the rail crash near Toledo that killed 69 people.
